lines.label: tmp6glw2wfj_region0
lines.text: las oportet me adducere et vocem meam audient et fie

lines.label: tmp6glw2wfj_region3
lines.text: non est pastor cujus non sunt oves

lines.label: tmp6glw2wfj_region4
lines.text: proprie videt lupum venientem et dimittit oves et fugit

lines.label: tmp6glw2wfj_region7
lines.text: bicis me dicit dominus iterum modicum et indebitis me

lines.label: tmp6glw2wfj_region10
lines.text: men amen dico vobis quia plorabitis et flebi

lines.label: tmp6glw2wfj_region13
lines.text: bimini sed tristicia vestra vertetur in gaudiuma

lines.label: tmp6glw2wfj_region17
lines.text: da Allelnga exonae tsacia vetta impeont corue
